item.title: Donald's sleepy Joe moment? Newsom shares video of Trump ‘sleeping’ in cabinet meeting - watch
item.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom shared a video of President Trump appearing to nod off during a cabinet meeting, with eyes narrowed and shut while officials briefed him. The White House denied the claims, stating Trump listened attentively throughout the three-hour meeting. This incident follows past reports and Trump's own criticisms of Joe Biden's stamina.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Stonehenge just got stranger: Archaeologists confirm massive man-made ring of pits underground
item.description: New research has confirmed that a vast ring of Neolithic pits, more than a mile wide and over 4,000 years old, was deliberately engineered near Stonehenge, not formed by nature. Using cutting-edge dating and soil-analysis techniques, researchers argue it reflects an ancient belief system inscribed into the land itself. The discovery suggests Stonehenge’s builders shaped not only monuments of stone, but also monuments of earth.
item.dc:creator: TOI Trending Desk

item.title: ‘AI nightmare’: Google CEO Sundar Pichai reveals the one threat that keeps him awake at night
item.description: Google CEO Sundar Pichai expresses deep concern over advanced deepfake technology. He believes this AI development poses a significant threat, making it difficult to distinguish real from fake content. This could lead to widespread deception, impacting everything from personal scams to political campaigns. Pichai urges swift action to establish safeguards against AI misuse.
item.dc:creator: TOI Tech Desk

item.title: Hasan Piker honored with Trinity College Dublin's Gold Medal of Honorary Patronage
item.description: Hasan Piker, known as HasanAbi, will receive Trinity College Dublin's prestigious Gold Medal of Honorary Patronage. The University Philosophical Society recognized his journalistic roots, honest commentary, and ability to dissect news with clarity. This honor highlights the growing influence of online commentators in shaping public discourse and marks a significant milestone in Piker's career.

item.title: Nina Lin refuses to say sorry after Target shoplifting clip goes viral while Asmongold urges Twitch to act
item.description: Twitch streamer Nina Lin faces backlash after a viral video allegedly shows her shoplifting from Target. Fellow streamer Asmongold questioned Twitch's inaction, amplifying the controversy as fans await a platform response.

item.title: Perez Hilton reacts as Brian Harpole breaks silence on strange hand signal claims in Charlie Kirk shooting case
item.description: Podcaster Perez Hilton has slammed online conspiracy theories surrounding Charlie Kirk's death, calling them "ridiculous" and "unsettling." Kirk's former security chief, Brian Harpole, vehemently denied claims that his hand movements were "signals" for the shooter, emphasizing the absurdity of such accusations. Harpole also defended other security personnel and Kirk's grieving wife against baseless online speculation.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Nina Lin banned again on Twitch after the Target shoplifting video goes viral
item.description: Twitch streamer Nina Lin has been banned for the third time, with the latest suspension occurring on December 2, 2025. This ban follows a viral video where viewers accused her of shoplifting from a Target store during a livestream. Her ambiguous response to the incident intensified online discussion and scrutiny.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Public execution in Afghanistan: Man sentenced to 'retaliatory punishment' for murder; thousands gather to watch
item.description: A convicted murderer was publicly executed in an Afghan stadium, with a victim's family member firing the fatal shots. This marks the 12th public execution since the Taliban's return to power in 2021. UN human rights officials condemned the act as "inhumane" and contrary to international law.
